domains.name: Software Architecture and Design Support

domains.description: DevOps, deployment, and maintenance: monitoring, maintenance/troubleshooting, and CI/CD support.

competencies.statement: The learner can use common office tools (word processing, spreadsheets, presentations) to produce clear workplace documents.
competencies.description: Produces a correctly formatted document, spreadsheet, or slide deck fit for a workplace audience.

competencies.statement: The learner can prepare and deliver an oral presentation that clearly conveys information, concepts, and ideas.
competencies.description: Plans and delivers a concise, well-structured spoken explanation to a team.

competencies.statement: The learner can support the application of prototyping methods during development when appropriate.
competencies.description: Chooses and applies a suitable prototyping approach to explore a design.

competencies.statement: The learner can contribute to implementing a development lifecycle and specifications, including helping map out a work plan under supervision.
competencies.description: Follows an SDLC and helps translate specifications into a work plan.

competencies.statement: The learner can help select and set up the tools and languages needed to produce the outputs in a work plan, under supervision.
competencies.description: Identifies appropriate tools/languages for a given deliverable.

competencies.statement: The learner can build program features using appropriate languages and development methods as part of a team.
competencies.description: Implements working features that meet a specification using suitable methods.

competencies.statement: The learner can help identify and develop the prototype best suited to a project's needs.
competencies.description: Evaluates prototype options and advances the most fitting one.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply a Software Requirement Specification (SRS) and document product requirements under supervision.
competencies.description: Reads an SRS correctly and records requirements accurately.

competencies.statement: The learner can contribute to preparing implementation planning documents.
competencies.description: Produces or updates a usable implementation plan artifact.

competencies.statement: The learner can support team consultations that assess a product's economic, operational, and technical feasibility.
competencies.description: Identifies feasibility considerations across those dimensions in a scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can coordinate with a project manager to communicate requirements and objectives clearly to other team members such as UX and QA.
competencies.description: Relays requirements accurately to the right stakeholders.

competencies.statement: The learner can support QA and risk assessments of quality-assurance requirements under supervision.
competencies.description: Helps identify QA requirements and risks for a feature.

competencies.statement: The learner can track a reported issue and work with the team to fix and re-test it until quality standards are met.
competencies.description: Manages an issue through fix and verification to closure.

competencies.statement: The learner can keep detailed notes documenting code changes and functions that must remain unchanged.
competencies.description: Records change notes precise enough for a teammate to follow.

competencies.statement: The learner can support the integration and test phase and record progress relevant to project success.
competencies.description: Contributes to integration/testing and reports progress.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor software to identify issues and report them clearly to senior team members.
competencies.description: Detects an issue and communicates it with the right detail.

competencies.statement: The learner can follow company-specific source-code management practices.
competencies.description: Uses the team's version-control workflow correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can support software design and system-structure work (data models, interfaces, algorithms) under supervision.
competencies.description: Contributes to a design artifact under guidance.

competencies.statement: The learner can help identify needed changes and apply them under direction from senior team members.
competencies.description: Recognizes a needed change and implements it as directed.

competencies.statement: The learner can contribute to implementing accessible and responsive web designs and applications.
competencies.description: Applies responsive/accessible practices to a UI task.

competencies.statement: The learner can participate in ongoing monitoring of platforms and applications for accessibility and compliance.
competencies.description: Uses monitoring signals to flag accessibility/compliance gaps.

competencies.statement: The learner can support maintenance, troubleshooting, and problem-solving under supervision.
competencies.description: Diagnoses and helps resolve a maintenance issue.

competencies.statement: The learner can recognize CI/CD concepts and support CI/CD configuration and integration.
competencies.description: Explains CI/CD purpose and assists with pipeline setup.
